guide.heading: Locate the Carousel outpost
guide.text: The Carousel outpost is located opposite the IDEA store checkout area inside the ULTRA shopping mall on Interchange. guide.text: The ambush spot, specifically Moreman's grave is located near the ZB-016 extraction in the east of Woods.

guide.text: To fulfill this objective, you have to pick up and read a note as well as pick up two quest items from the grave. Moreman's dogtag should be transferred to the off-raid quest inventory to not lose it in subsequent raids. It will be needed later.

guide.heading: Retrieve more information about the ambush from Moreman's phone
guide.text: Craft Moreman's audio tape #1 and Moreman's audio tape #2 at the Workbench level 1 in the Hideout and listen to them. Electricity is required during the entire process, otherwise it will be interrupted.

guide.heading: Obtain Intelligence Center level 3
guide.text: Upgrade the Intelligence Center to level 3 in the Hideout.

guide.heading: Contact the Bogatyr squad
guide.text: Contact Voevoda through the radio system at the Intelligence Center in the Hideout. First enter the frequency "35.70", as hinted at from the First piece of code note and Second piece of code note. Next enter the code "27.893.2000" as hinted at from Strelets' note.

guide.heading: Gain access to Lightkeeper
guide.text:
Lightkeeper can be found on the Lighthouse location. He is located in a locked area on the 3rd floor of the lighthouse building at the peninsula territory.

The bridge that leads to the lighthouse is guarded by Zryachiy and full of Claymores. To safely pass the bridge and speak to Lightkeeper, an encoded Digital secure DSP radio transmitter is required. It deactivates the claymores and has Zryachiy not shoot you. The questline to obtain one starts with the quest To the Light - Trust but Verify.

Harming Zryachiy, one of his followers, or a Lightkeeper acquainted PMC in the lighthouse premises will decode your Digital secure DSP radio transmitter if you have it equipped (Attention: Unequipping it does not prevent this in local PvE game mode raids). PMC's that are acquainted with Lightkeeper can kill unacquainted intruders without penalty.

guide.heading: Bring all the Bogatyr squad's items to Lightkeeper
guide.text: Transfer Taran's postcard, Voevoda's audio recorder, Strelets' amulet, Moreman's dogtag and the Bogatyrs patch to the in-raid quest inventory and hand them over to Lightkeeper.

guide.heading: Wait for Voevoda to reach out
guide.text: Wait 6-12 hours for Voevoda to reach out, then contact him through the radio system at the Intelligence Center Hideout. Enter frequency "35.70" and the code "27.893.2000" again.

guide.text:

guide.heading: Contact Voevoda

This objective only happens if you have not completed Falling Skies.

Shoot a yellow flare into the sky while being at the Woods transit on Reserve. If the flare doesn't reach a certain height, the quest objective won't complete. You can use either the handheld RSP-30 yellow flare which can be bought at Prapor LL1 or a 26x75mm yellow flare cartridge which can be bought at Jaeger LL1, and is fired from a signal pistol. If you use the handheld RSP-30 yellow flare, make sure to aim it upwards, but not too much or it lands behind you.

guide.heading: Reach the engine room
guide.text:
Head to level 0 on the east side of the ship and find the locked door with a keycard reader right next to the control room.

Continue to navigate the ship, and take the stairs to level 1 to find the doors to the engine room. Unseal them then enter the room and go downstairs to level -2.

guide.heading: Find a way into the icebreaker superstructure
guide.text:
The player needs to go to the extraction zone, but instead of extracting, go two levels down, turn around the helipad, and go all the way to the side of the ship, and go up to level 3 to find a door with a chain.

A group of Black Division operatives will be waiting for the player on the helipad, and another group under the helipad.

Once you reach the objective, try to open the damaged door locked with chains and you will be asked to find an explosive. You can now extract from the Icebreaker. At this point the quest Stick to It is unlocked.

guide.text:

guide.text: Once the crew quarters have been cleared and The Wedge killed, head to level 5 of the ship and get outside of the quarters to take the stairs and find a code-locked door leading to the upper decks.

guide.heading: Use the correct access code
guide.text: Use the code 3-1-2-2-2-0 on the pad to unlock the door. The code is the same every raid, does not change, and is the same for every door of the zone that leads to the exterior.

guide.heading: Locate compartment C-1
guide.text: The C-1 compartment is located on level 7 next to the exit leading outside. The Compartment C-1 keycard is required to open it.

guide.heading: Reach the upper decks
guide.text: Exit the level 7 rooms using the code 3-1-2-2-2-0 and go upstairs to find the bridge.

guide.heading: Thaw the hatch on the roof of the bridge
guide.text: The hatch is located on the roof of the bridge, a frozen hatch with a frozen lever.

guide.heading: Find something to thaw the hatch on the roof of the bridge

guide.text: Use the buttons below to select the ending you want to pursue.

guide.heading: Arrive at the entrance pathway to the port Terminal
guide.text: You will have to use the corresponding access item on the keycard swiping system, or the intercom call button for the Survivor ending on the intercom between the times 21:00 and 06:00. The corresponding access item will be accepted and the intercom will tell you to proceed to the gate. If you do not have a proper access item, or it is the wrong time of day, the guard will deny you entry via the intercom.

guide.heading: Access the port Terminal
guide.text:
If you are authorized to approach, you will have to follow the left road to approach the transit area. Once you approach the transit area, your weapon will be automatically lowered. You won't be able to transit without having Secure container Alpha-1 with TerraGroup evidence in your task inventory if you are doing the Savior ending.

A few actions can get you killed by the port garrison:
• Going further than the first anti-tank barrier without presenting an access item.
• Going outside of the road around the transit area.
• Pulling out a weapon, or getting a weapon back in your hands after it has been lowered.

guide.heading: Notes:
guide.text:
• If you die with the Secure container Alpha-1 with TerraGroup evidence, a new one will be sent to you via in-game mail.
• The RFID keycard with unknown name can be purchased once per raid from Lightkeeper for 1× TerraGroup "Blue Folders" materials. Note: Free special slot required.
• Prapor's letter for the port checkpoint can be purchased twice per trader reset from Prapor for 5,000,000 Roubles.

guide.heading: Pass the security check
guide.text: The security check consists of a cinematic of you entering the Terminal area.

guide.heading: Locate the armory with your confiscated equipment
guide.text: You will need to find your way to the armory building, and enter the armory to retrieve your equipment. You will have to find the corresponding key on your way to the armory. Once you have retrieved your equipment and have exited the armory to the west, a squad of Black Division operatives will approach the armory building from the southwest. You will have to fight them in order to continue to the next objective

guide.heading: Obtain the keycard to unlock the service passage
guide.text: You will have to find the Black Division keycard located inside the seaport Terminal building (MS) west of the armory. The keycard is in a Weapon box (6x2) on a tipped over ATM. You will have to fight a squad of Black Division operatives guarding the inside of the building before getting the keycard.

guide.heading: Access the Terminal loading zone
guide.text: To access the loading zone, you will have to get through the admin building. You will have to fight Scavs on the path to it and a team of Black Division operatives waiting at the entrance of the building. Once all Black Division operatives have been neutralized, you have to enter the building and swipe the Black Division keycard at the scanner next to the door. There are several resupply resources (Provisions, medical items) scattered about in the hallway immediately inside the door. Scavs spawning ahead will attempt to enter the hallway from the far end while you are inside.

guide.heading: Locate the way into the fuel depot
guide.text:
To continue, you must get through the metal gate blocking your path. You can do this by either using a nearby found SZ-1 explosive charge to open the door, by pushing it open with Elite level Strength, or by pushing it open together with another player.

You will have to fight a squad of Black Division operatives around the various SZ-1 explosive charge spawns. It is recommend to clear them first before looking for the charge.

guide.heading: Drain the water in the pumping station
guide.text:
*Electrical panels can be repaired with bare hands, but the chance to succeed is low. If you fail a repair, the panel will inflict damage to your arms.

You will need to find and repair one to five electrical panels scattered around Terminal in order to restore power to the pumping station. The amount of panels that are required to be repaired depends on the number of players in the raid:
• Solo players will always have a single panel to repair (Either panel number 9 or 10).
• With 2-5 players, at least 1, but up to 5 panels will need to be repaired across all panel locations.

Two Toolsets can be found on Terminal in static locations, both are guaranteed to spawn every raid.

guide.heading: Obtain the key to the gate blocking the road to the pier
guide.text: The key can be obtained from a safe inside the pumping station, only after draining the water.

guide.heading: Locate the exit leading to the pier
guide.text:
You now need to access the pier to reach the Zubr Boat extraction. You can reach the door to the pier in a few ways:
• You can go through the container loading bay in the east, this avoids fighting the Scav Boss that can spawn, but requires backtracking, and is a longer path. (Green path)
• You can go through the container loading bay in the center, but you might have to fight the Scav Boss that can spawn, in addition to the team of Black Division operatives nearby. (Blue path)
• You can go through the container loading bay in the west, sticking close to the water, this may avoid fighting the Scav Boss that can spawn, but can end up in a long distance battle with a squad of Black Division operatives at the end of the loading bay. (Purple path)

On all possible paths, you will have to fight squads of Black Division operatives before reaching the pier door.

guide.heading: Escape from Tarkov
guide.text:
Once the Pier door has been opened, all players in the raid will have 3 minutes to reach the Zubr Boat extraction at the end of the pier before the extraction becomes unavailable regardless of the current raid time left. You will have to fight a final team of Black Division operatives on the pier, before reaching the boat. The extraction timer coincides with the three minute timer, once the timer is up, any players in the extraction zone will escape and a cinematic related to the ending you chose will start.

Successfully completing the raid will allow you to obtain one of the game's endings. Upon dying or extracting, the state of your character is returned to what it was before entering Terminal, besides the consumed access item.

guide.heading: Locate A.P.'s room in the Health Resort/Obtain A.P.'s data storage device and his personal belongings
guide.text:
A.P.'s room is east wing room 305 at the health resort on Shoreline. The Sliderkey flash drive marked with A.P. is stuck into the laptop on the table. A.P.'s belongings in the form of TerraGroup corporate apartment key can be found on the right nightstand. The optional Fragment of an unknown document can be found on the left nightstand.

The optional Guard post note to locate the room can be found on the first floor of the health resort west wing, on the desk next to the security room at the southern entrance.

guide.heading: Decrypt the flash drive from A.P.'s room
guide.text: Craft the Decrypted Sliderkey flash drive marked with A.P. at the Intelligence Center level 1 in the Hideout. Electricity is required during the entire process, otherwise it will be interrupted.

guide.heading: Ask Mechanic for help
guide.text: Visit Mechanic in the menu through the trader screen and ask him about the flash drive. He will say that he cannot help, but that Elektronik can if you hand over 5,000,000 Roubles.

guide.heading: Hand over 5,000,000 Roubles and the A.P. flash drive to Mechanic
guide.text: Hand 5,000,000 Roubles and the Decrypted Sliderkey flash drive marked with A.P. over to Mechanic through the trader screen.

guide.heading: Wait for the news from Elektronik
guide.text:
If you haven't had contact with Mr. Kerman before: Wait 6-12 hours then visit Mechanic in the menu through the trader screen.

If you had contact with Mr. Kerman before: Wait 1 and half a hour for Mr. Kerman to contact you and speak to him.

guide.heading: Integrate the files from A.P.'s flash drive into a keycard and access the hidden room in his apartment
guide.text:
You first have to craft the Reprogrammed keycard for A.P.'s apartment lock (Green) at the Intelligence Center level 1 in the Hideout. The blue and red ones are false leads.

A.P.'s apartment is apartment 1 on the second floor of the Cardinal apartment complex on Streets of Tarkov. A TerraGroup corporate apartment key is required to enter it. Once inside the apartment, you have to go down the hallway to find the hidden room opened with the crafted keycard. In the room are 4 notes to pick up and read.

guide.heading: Rewards
guide.text:
• +128,000 EXP
• Unlocks achievement Trail of Breadcrumbs

guide.text: See requirements.

guide.heading: Locate a place connected to the Eye of the World/Learn more about the cultist's victim from the torture room
guide.text:
To fulfill these objectives, you have to locate the Cultist's torture house on Lighthouse and pick up and listen to the audio tape found there.

The Cult victim's apartment key required for the next objective can also be obtained in the house.

guide.heading: Locate the cult victim's apartment
guide.text: The wanted apartment is located on the third floor of the old apartment building behind the Klimov shopping mall on Streets of Tarkov. A Cult victim's apartment key is required to enter it.

guide.heading: Investigate the victim's apartment/Obtain the victim's first audio tape and the book the Cultists planted
guide.text: To fulfill these objectives, you have to pick up and read 2 notes as well as pick up and listen to an audio tape from the office inside the apartment. The door has to be breached.

guide.heading: Ask Mechanic about the Eye of the World
guide.text: Visit Mechanic in the menu through the trader screen and ask him about the Eye of the World.

guide.heading: Locate and neutralize a Cultist priest
guide.text: Kill a Cultist priest on any location.

guide.heading: Obtain more information about the Eye of the World
guide.text:
*Only one of the keys is required to complete the objective.

To fulfill this objective, you have to pick up and read the Cultist priest's note from one of the marked rooms on Customs, Streets of Tarkov or Reserve. Note: The item doesn't spawn before the previous objective is completed.

guide.heading: Customs
guide.text: Marked room on the third floor of the three-story dorms building. A Dorm room 314 marked key is required to enter it.

guide.heading: Streets of Tarkov
guide.text: Marked room on the third floor of the northern abandoned factory building. A Abandoned factory marked key is required to enter it.

guide.heading: RB-BK
guide.text: Marked room on the first floor of the black pawn barrack building. A RB-BK marked key is required to enter it.

guide.heading: RB-PKPM
guide.text: Marked room next to the command office in the underground tunnel system. A RB-PKPM marked key is required to enter it.

guide.heading: RB-VO
guide.text: Marked room in the security barrack building on Reserve. A RB-VO marked key is required to enter it.

guide.heading: Locate the place marked with the Eye of the World on Lighthouse/Investigate the cultist room in the chalet/Obtain the victim's key
guide.text:
The wanted place is the small southern bedroom on the second floor of the northern blue chalet on Lighthouse. The Victim's note to pick up and read can be found on the adjacent balcony.

The Station 14-4 KORD Arshavin K. pass (Damaged) is located on an ATV in front of the garage opposite the chalet.

guide.heading: Locate the place marked with the Eye of the World on Woods
guide.text: The wanted place is a house in the dilapidated village in the north of Woods. The Newspaper clipping from the cultists' house to pick up and read can be found on a whiteboard next to the desk.

guide.heading: Locate the place marked with the Eye of the World on Shoreline/Investigate the area/Repair the Sordi tower
guide.text: The wanted place is a red metal shack at the radio tower near the "Road to Customs" extraction on Shoreline. The Programmer's note to pick up and read can be found on a dead body next to the tower. To repair the tower, a Toolset has to be used inside the shack.

guide.heading: Learn more about Station 14-4 KORD from Mechanic
guide.text: Visit Mechanic in the menu through the trader screen and ask him about the Eye of the World again.

guide.heading: Restore Arshavin's keycard
guide.text: Craft the Station 14-4 KORD Arshavin K. pass (Restored) at the Intelligence Center level 1 in the Hideout. Electricity is required during the entire process, otherwise it will be interrupted.

guide.heading: Gain access to NGO Cobalt's secret facility
guide.text: NGO Cobalt's secret facility is located in the basement of the power station on Interchange. A Station 14-4 KORD Arshavin K. pass (Restored) is required to enter it.

guide.heading: Restore power at the station
guide.text: To restore the power you have to swipe the Station 14-4 KORD Arshavin K. pass (Restored) at the keycard panel directly next to the entrance door.

guide.heading: Turn on the cooling system in the server room
guide.text: The server room is located behind the grate door. To turn on the cooling system, flip the lever in the back.

guide.heading: Install a flash drive to download the data
guide.text: The Secure Flash drive has to be stashed to the left of the cooling system lever in the server room.

guide.heading: Investigate ARRS Station 14-4 KORD thoroughly
guide.text: To fulfill this objective, you have to pick up and listen to the Mysterious audio tape from the safe next to the entrance door. The safe opens automatically after turning on the cooling system.

guide.heading: Survive and extract from Interchange
guide.text: Extract from Interchange with either the "Survived" or "Run-Through" extraction status.

guide.heading: Find a way to disconnect the station from external agents
guide.text: Return to the secret facility on Interchange and pick up and read the ARRS station mechanic's notes from the big desk.

guide.heading: Restore the ARRS station to backup settings
guide.text:
Turn on the power again, then go inside the server room and press the button under the table.

Note: Only 1 player per raid can press the button and get progress on this objective. If you can't interact with it, return in a new raid.

guide.heading: Collect the flash drive from the ARRS station
guide.text: Pick up the Flash drive for ARRS station from the server next to the cooling system lever.

guide.heading: Survive and extract from Interchange
guide.text: Extract from Interchange with either the "Survived" or "Run-Through" extraction status.

guide.heading: Hand over the flash drive with data to Mechanic
guide.text: Hand the Flash drive for ARRS station over to Mechanic through the trader screen.

guide.heading: Read the ARRS station specifications
guide.text: Read the ARRS system specifications from the handbook.

guide.text:

• Unlocks achievement When the Light Fades

guide.heading: Escape Ground Zero
guide.text: Finish the tutorial raid by extracting via the "Klimov Street" extraction which is located behind the "Skyside" business center. During the tutorial, numerous hints on controls and game mechanics are displayed, but none of them need to be followed in order to complete the raid.

guide.heading: Talk to Therapist
guide.text: Visit Therapist in the menu through the trader screen and hand over 250,000 Roubles when the dialogue option appears.

guide.heading: Rewards
guide.text: • Unlocks Streets of Tarkov in the location selection

guide.heading: Ragman - Interchange
guide.text: Extract from Interchange with either the "Survived" or "Run-Through" extraction status, or visit the location 3 times.

guide.heading: Rewards
guide.text:
• Unlocks Skier as trader
• Unlocks Customs in the location selection

guide.heading: Skier - Customs
guide.text: Extract from Customs with either the "Survived" or "Run-Through" extraction status, or visit the location 3 times.

guide.heading: Skier - Woods
guide.text: Kill any 3 targets on Woods and extract with either the "Survived" or "Run-Through" extraction status, or visit the location 3 times. The kills don't need to be performed in the same raid as the "survive" objective.

guide.heading: Rewards
guide.text:
• Unlocks Peacekeeper as trader
• Unlocks Shoreline in the location selection

guide.heading: Terminal
guide.text:
To complete the next few objectives you have to go to the south-east corner of Shoreline and interact with the intercom at the watchtower in front of the Terminal.

Be careful not to get too close to the Terminal wall, as there are guards that will shoot at anyone. Do not try to kill them, they return fire with deadly precision. Interacting with the intercom too many times after being told to leave will also lead to your death by the guards.

guide.heading: Prapor - Reserve
guide.text: Extract from Shoreline with either the "Survived" or "Run-Through" extraction status, or visit the location 3 times. Afterwards visit Prapor in the menu through the trader screen and hand over 5 Dogtags when the dialogue option appears. The Dogtags can be obtained by taking them off dead PMCs (they do not have to be killed by your hand).

guide.heading: Rewards
guide.text: • Unlocks Reserve in the location selection

guide.heading: Mechanic - Lighthouse
guide.text: Visit Mechanic in the menu through the trader screen and hand over 8,000 Dollars when the dialogue option appears. Dollars can be purchased from Peacekeeper with Roubles.

guide.heading: Rewards
guide.text: • Unlocks Lighthouse in the location selection

guide.heading: Secret TerraGroup facility The Lab
guide.text: One of the following two transits has to be used to access The Lab:

guide.heading: Streets of Tarkov to The Lab
guide.text: Underground entrance in front of the Klimova 16A building with the Cosmonaut painting. TerraGroup Labs access keycard required. Transits are only available 1 min after raid start.

guide.heading: Factory to The Lab
guide.text: In the sewer tunnel connected to the flooded area in the underground. TerraGroup Labs access keycard required. Transits are only available 1 min after raid start.

guide.heading: Search the top management offices
guide.text: Laboratory manager's office (O21) on the second level.

guide.heading: Search the server room
guide.text: Next to the hangar on the first level.

guide.heading: Locate the escape path through the drainage
guide.text: In the basement at the "Sewage Conduit" extraction. The extraction does not need to be activated for this objective. You do not need to survive the raid.

guide.heading: Rewards
guide.text:
• Unlocks The Lab in the location selection
• Unlocks achievement Pathfinder
